title: Charge for Verified Agent Work, Not Another Seat
thesis: A proposed pay-per-completed-workflow pilot should bill only when the result and its evidence can be independently checked.
body: The proposed pilot would define task scope, origin agent, receiving agent and a durable completion receipt. A failed route or unsupported model assertion is not a billable verified success. Pricing, operational capacity, margins and buyer demand remain unverified. This is a pilot concept, not an advertised enterprise SLA.
